name: flexible wheelset
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 考虑弹性变形的轮对模型。
usage_overview: 用于在车辆—轨道相互作用及滚动噪声分析中纳入车轮、车轴的弹性变形，以描述轮对的高阶振动和高频声源特征。

complete_examples.text: Based on the “set-in-right-position” rule for the finite element matrix, the global matrix (퐌ww and 퐊ww) of a flexible wheelset could be assembled.
From the above numerical examples and descriptions, it can be concluded that the flexible wheelset model has high precision in the frequency domain analysis.
Based on the geometric and physical parameters of the wheelset, the flexible wheelset matrices are established by commercial finite element software.
ABAQUS commercial finite element software is taken as an example to establish the finite element model of flexible wheelset with eight-node solid element.
